# authwise_guard_node_group_grants (Resource)

What every member of a Guard node group may reach: the full names of resources, nodes and node groups of its network, as an authoritative set. A granted node group means every member of it. A member's reach is its own grants (`authwise_guard_node_grants`), its groups' grants, and the members of any group granted.

A grant made out of band, such as one made in the Guard console, is removed on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Argo CD's pods reach the git server and every ops host; the ops hosts
# reach the cluster's pods. Grants are authoritative sets of resource, node
# and node group names.
resource "authwise_guard_node_group_grants" "gfk_pods" {
  node_group = authwise_guard_node_group.gfk_pods.name
  grants = [
    authwise_guard_resource.git.name,
    authwise_guard_node_group.ops.name,
  ]
}

resource "authwise_guard_node_group_grants" "ops" {
  node_group = authwise_guard_node_group.ops.name
  grants     = [authwise_guard_node_group.gfk_pods.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grants` (Set of String) Full resource names of the associated grants.
- `node_group` (String) Full resource name of the node group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the group's full name.
terraform import authwise_guard_node_group_grants.gfk_pods tenants/t-01/networks/n-01/nodeGroups/ng-01
```
